description: A ratio bar whose two shares grow and shrink as you drag it; coffee and milk, with it always clear which side has more.
interactionNotes: Drag anywhere on the bar and the divide edge sticks to the pointer while both shares update live. A share below 30% gets a short, pill-shaped bar, and a label without room jumps above the bar. The keyboard works the same way: arrows step one at a time, PageUp/PageDown by ten, and Home/End all the way to the edge.

props.defaultValue: Initial coffee share as a percentage (1 to 99) in the uncontrolled state.
props.value: Controlled value; when you provide it, dragging and the keyboard only call `onChange` and the value does not change on its own.
props.onChange: Returns the rounded coffee share on every change (drag or keyboard).
props.coffeeFill: Fill color of the coffee bar; its label ink is the `--cm-coffee-word/num` CSS variables and is changed separately.
props.milkFill: Fill color of the milk bar; its ink uses `--cm-milk-word/num`.
props.gap: Spacing between the two bars at the divide line, in px.
props.tallHeight: Bar height in the normal state; the slim state is always 26px.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the bar; by default it is composed from the two labels.
props.className: Extra class on the component's container.

tips: The divide edge is only a visual guide and nothing sits on it; the whole bar is grabbable, even when one of the shares has become very slim.
Each side's label first sits inside its bar and jumps above when there is no room — each side decides independently; one tightening says nothing about the other.
The geometry stays physical: coffee is on the left and dragging tracks the pointer 1:1; only the reading order of the labels is right-to-left (like "Coffee 65%").

The fill colors are deliberately desaturated and semi-transparent, and 'presence' works through opacity rather than brightness — because the fills are transparent, brightness would have done the opposite.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` all the springs become instant; dragging is already instant so it never lags behind the pointer.
The color variables (`--cm-*`) are defined in `coffee-milk.css`; the dark theme is swapped by its own selector, and a `.light` island inside a dark page still works.
